Product Features

  • Dimensions: 100 x 50 x 35 cm, for a long sofa or couch, 35 cm wide for a comfortable table and a pleasant, flat surface.
  • Color: This modern, minimalist coffee table in high-gloss white is perfect for contemporary living rooms. The simple and versatile white surface complements modern, bright, and luxurious interiors, adding a touch of luxury to any room.
  • Load capacity: This sturdy chipboard table can support up to 45 kg. It retains its shape even after prolonged use and is perfect for your everyday storage needs.
  • Storage space: Two spacious drawers offer practical storage space for everyday items and ensure a simple and practical design that keeps your living room tidy.
  • High-gloss surface: The top and bottom of the drawers as well as the outside are highly polished, ensuring a beautiful appearance and easy cleaning.
  • Glass top: Fingerprints and watermarks can be easily wiped away, simplifying daily maintenance. It not only effectively showcases the storage space inside, but also ensures order and brightness in any room.
  • The plate is made of tempered glass, which is durable, shatterproof and resilient, thus retaining its beauty even after years of use.
  • LED light strip: The LED light strip beneath the glass top can be controlled via smartphone or Bluetooth. It creates a warm, inviting light, perfect for watching movies, and its variable color modes make it ideal for lively parties. The interplay of light and shadow transforms the atmosphere of your living room and turns your small coffee table into a real mood-setter.
  • USB power supply – Includes 5V 2A USB data cable (USB plug not included) for connecting to TVs, computers, power banks, and other devices. Safe and convenient for indoor use.
  • Applications: From daily coffee breaks and storing small items to serving tea and water at gatherings with friends and creating a cozy movie atmosphere – this double-layered structure combines lighting and storage. This allows a single coffee table to easily adapt to various life situations, thus increasing efficiency and quality of life.
